cards.note: external plugin is an npm package with dsh.bundle.patch, installed through the single official profile path (dsh plugin --profile web add); no repository-plugin/.dsh-plugin files exist.
manifest already declares dsh.client; no legacy dshClient field and no dsh.plugin.json anywhere in the tree.
dsh.client {platform: web, inject} plus exports['./client'] present; the packed-style scan resolved it and the live boot manifest entry id equals the package name.
every property-read client service (slots, sessions, workspaces, uiWorkspace, locale) is declared in the plugin's inject array; no ctx.get on an undeclared service.
all consumed services are guaranteed by the web profile and declared as hard injects; the plugin has no optional host service and no ctx.get probe.
the only session-event listener was the retired session_projcache title write-behind; no event.kind/type read remains in the tree.
condition not met at alpha.2: ClientSessions provides ctx.sessions on the client (list/open/search/searchResultLimit), so no Node-half aggregation or /state route is needed.
the plugin neither tails task/run output nor references tasks.peek/tasks.read.
no httpServer/webServer/tasks/jobs injection and no task-event listener; the host half only uses ctx.effect.
no ImageAttachmentRef usage, no read_image call, no persisted image metadata or image schema.
the plugin neither registers, wraps, parses nor snapshot-tests read_image.
no custom DeepSeek LLM adapter, image-request interceptor, or attachment/upload cache.
the client half consumes the controller/Remote-backed services (ctx.sessions, ctx.workspaces, ctx.uiWorkspace); it never touches the Host APIProxy.
target is alpha.2 (not alpha.1) and the plugin produces no persisted SessionEvents; A2-01 restores the retention semantics anyway.
no host-source patch and no import from internal session-view paths; the 0.1.1-era dist-bundle patch memo is retired in favour of the public slots seam.
no launcher wrapper, SDK/ACP integration, or direct profile-file read; DSH_HOME is only used by the checks outside the plugin tree.
the plugin ships no headless wrapper and parses no stdout/stderr.
no tool-presentation mode, PTC preset, or dispatch-waterfall usage.
no permission/approval/WebFetch policy plugin and no shipped-preset override.
the plugin registers no custom loopback HTTP/WS/RPC route or /api page; its bundle is served by the official /plugins combo route behind the stock auth gate.
not a model-provider plugin; no provider login configuration is contributed.
localization already uses the public ctx.locale.register(namespace, {zh, en}) seam; the plugin carries no custom i18n patch to retire.
no subagent orchestration or provider/model/effort selector.
deployment-level privacy review only (the plugin code calls no LLM adapter and needs no change); the fixture does not set deployment config.
no persistent PowerShell/Bash or Windows directory-picker compatibility workaround in the plugin.
the plugin does not enable session-log-deepseek; its bundle layer inserts one row and overrides no telemetry config.
target-tag dsh web --no-open on an isolated DSH_HOME: token URL -> 303 + cookie -> __DSH_BOOT__.entries contains the package name, and the combo route serves the closure-factory bundle.
the plugin registers no structured-question answerer and no user-questions/request listener.
no agent-preset inference from persisted sessions and no agent-presets roots config.
no isTokenDelta import and no first-token/TPS computation.
the plugin is not a profile/bundle maintainer reusing the dsh-base composition and states no telemetry stance; its layer only inserts its own row.
the plugin does not import @earendil-works/pi-ai and declares no provider/auth packages.
dsh-client-runtime removed from dsh.client.inject and peers; ClientContext re-homed to @deepseek-ai/cordis, session/workspace types to the controller /client entries, navigation to ui-workspace.
the bundle now registers window.__ModuleLoader__.load({id: package name}); assembly row name and package.json name already matched; the live boot manifest entry id was verified.
the plugin reads no session timeline or message content; it only searches and lists sessions through ctx.sessions and never touches conversation-node snapshots.
no composer DOM manipulation, draft injection, or selection/caret work.
the retained source renders no MarkdownText/fenced CodeBlocks and imports nothing from ui-primitives (component bodies are elided).
the client half never reads ctx.connection or ctx.connection.api; history/transcript reads are not part of its surface.
the plugin does not construct or assert subagent descriptors.
startSession now goes through ctx.uiWorkspace (added to inject); list/create stay on ctx.workspaces; no baselinesReady/recentWorkspaceId read.
the plugin produces no third-party persisted SessionEvents (its host half is a stub after the title write-behind was retired).
the one Remote-backed call (ctx.sessions.search) resolves through the RemoteResult branch (result.ok / result.error.message) and assumes no thrown carrier failure.

peer cohort re-based on alpha.2 (cordis -> @deepseek-ai/cordis ^4.0.2, DSH peers ^0.1.2-alpha.2) and the dissolved dsh-client-runtime peer removed; resolved in an isolated dir and semver-checked against the shipped versions.
the repo carries no startup wrapper or Node-version workaround (no forced Node 22, no skipped dsh web); the acceptance boot ran on Node 24.21 outside the failure window.
the plugin does not consume pluginInventory/list or validate PluginInventorySnapshot.
the retained inject face exposes no hostInfo observable and never calls host.describe or reads ctx.remote.$host.
the plugin mounts no sessionProjections consumer and lists none of the affected tool/agent packages as peers; the shipped dsh-base bundle already mounts session-projection.
the plugin registers, reads and writes no settings namespace, host-side or on the client.
